english:
Auto Rifle Combatant Kills progress a Counter, granting 50% Counter Progress. Kills while within 15 meters of 3 enemies grant 100% Counter Progress, as do Kills while at 5 stacks.

Counter Progress persists through stow.

Reaching 100% Counter Progress grants a stack of Targeting Autoloader for 15 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks. The buff is refreshable.

Targeting Autoloader benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• Refills 20%|20%|30%|40%|40% of the Magazine
• 10%|13%|16%|18%|20% increased Auto Rifle damage

This stacks with other buffs. The buff is removed when a non-Auto Rifle Weapon is readied.
